title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, bump GH Actions and deps
author: Priya Raman
description: Consolidate disparate GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing and release automation into a smaller, faster set of coordinated workflows and bump several GH Action versions and pinned deps to reduce noise and improve cache hit rates. Motivation: the repo currently has ~8 overlapping workflows that duplicate matrix definitions, run redundant lint/test steps, and cause long CI queue times and cache fragmentation. This PR: 1) Introduces unified workflows: .github/workflows/lint-test.yml (lint + unit/integration tests with targeted matrices), .github/workflows/release.yml (tag-driven release with improved artifact promotion and retries), .github/workflows/hygiene.yml (periodic dependency and actions bump job). 2) Bumps GH Actions/platform runners and standardizes Node versions to Node 20 where possible; upgrades actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, setup-node@v4; updates self-hosted runner labels to reduce cross-repo interference. 3) Adds centralized caching keys and restores to improve cache hit rate across packages; introduces job-level conditional caching to avoid stale caches on workflow splits. 4) Removes legacy per-package CI files and replaces them with small harnesses that call repo-level scripts in scripts/ci; updates docs/ci.md to reflect the new flow. 5) Adds lightweight release-automation improvements (idempotent artifact publish, better tagging semantics, and transient failure retries). Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove deprecated files; - [x] Bump GH Actions and node versions; - [x] Validate caches across linux/windows/macos matrices; - [x] Update docs and onboarding notes; - [x] Run staged rollout and monitor first-week CI metrics. See Linear ENG-9021 and ENG-9902 for rollout plan. Note: kept one legacy workflow in redwood-examples for backcompat with older templates (will be removed in follow-up).
